features.name: Create invoices in under a minute
features.description: Big create button under the monthly cards. Draft editor with sections for client, line items, summary (subtotal, tax, total, paid, balance due) and payment settings; Finish at the top. Number, date and due date (none, 30 days, custom) are editable.
features.reason: The core job; local data and PDF.

features.name: Estimates converted to invoices with one gesture
features.description: Estimate documents share the editor; one action creates the invoice from the estimate.

features.name: Customisable templates
features.description: Template carousel with live preview, logo size, colour palette, header toggles, font size, high-contrast text, custom labels, terms and conditions.
features.reason: One Sbu layout is enough; colour palette conflicts with the single-accent rule.

features.name: Taxes and discounts per item or on total
features.description: Item form with name, price, quantity, unit, tax and discount type (none, percent, fixed); tax and discount also on the total; withholdings listed in the description.
features.reason: Needed on every invoice; pure arithmetic.

features.name: Images and notes attached
features.description: Attach images or PDFs and extra notes to the document.

features.name: Signature
features.description: Signature pad with clear and save; printed under the totals with the name.

features.name: Share or print
features.description: Action menu: send, export, print, sign, duplicate, delete; system share sheet.
features.reason: Share sheet, Mail and UIPrintInteractionController, no server.

features.name: Clients from the phone contacts
features.description: Client list with sorting and tags, add form (name, email, phone, address) or import from Contacts.

features.name: Saved items
features.description: Items catalogue with unit, tax and a save toggle when adding to an invoice.

features.name: Status and paid stamp
features.description: Status (sent, paid, due today, overdue) shown in the list in colour and as a stamp on the preview; record a payment with method (cash, check, card).
features.reason: Paid / unpaid status computed from local dates and payments.

features.name: Monthly income cards
features.description: Horizontal cards per month with total and change versus the previous month; list grouped by month with a filter (All, paid, unpaid).
features.reason: The one figure on the home screen could be the month total; percentages may be dropped.

features.name: Reports
features.description: Dashboard with balance chart, total invoiced, revenue by client, estimate status, tax summary.
features.reason: Local aggregation with Swift Charts; keep minimal.

features.name: Notification when the client opens or pays
features.description: Push notifications 'invoice paid', 'estimate accepted', 'opened'.
features.reason: Needs a hosted invoice link and a server.

features.name: Online payments (card, PayPal, Stripe, Apple Pay)
features.description: Client pays from the invoice link through connected processors.

features.name: Receipt scanning and expenses
features.description: Scan receipts with OCR into an expense form, categories, expense dashboard and export.

features.name: AI estimate builder, voice to invoice, AI assistant
features.description: Generate itemised estimates from a photo or text, dictate an invoice, chat assistant that also generates logos.

features.name: Time tracking
features.description: Time entries per client turned into invoice lines.

features.name: Recurring invoices and automatic reminders
features.description: Invoices repeated on a schedule and reminders emailed to clients before and after the due date.
features.reason: Emailing clients automatically needs a server; a local reminder to the user is possible.

features.name: Account, sync and team
features.description: Sign-in, sync across devices, team members with roles and QR invite.

features.name: Tax and currency settings
features.description: Country, default tax rate, currency with confirmation to update existing documents.

features.name: Data export and import
features.description: App settings offer export and import of data.
features.reason: Without sync, a local backup file is how users keep their data.

features.name: Widgets
features.description: Home and lock screen widgets with setup tutorials.

screens.name: Invoices home
elements: settings gear and search at the top
horizontal monthly cards with total and percent change
rows: icon, client, number, amount, status word in colour
bottom tabs incl. Tools and Reports

screens.name: Customize
elements: logo size, colour, header toggles, font size, labels, signature

flows.name: Record payment
steps: status becomes Paid and the stamp appears

fields.name: name
fields.note: descriptions up to ~1400 chars per a reviewer

data_model.storage: Account with cloud sync and team sharing. For Sbu: SwiftData on device, export/import file as backup.

monetization.model: Free download, hard paywall during onboarding with a 3-day trial, then weekly or annual subscription.
monetization.price: Weekly 8.99 USD (variants 5.99-9.99), yearly 98.99 USD, monthly 8.99-12.99 in some variants.
paywalled_features: creating and sending invoices beyond the trial
monetization.notes: Paywall comes before the first real invoice, after setup, rating prompt and AI demo. Annual plan shown as a weekly price.

user_pains.pain: Not compliant with non Anglo-Saxon (Italian) tax rules
user_pains.evidence: review: improvements to issue legal tax documents promised and never made; review: unusable for a proper invoice
